an4.103:1.8: evamevaṃ kho bhikkhave cattāro’me kumbhūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.103:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo tuccho hoti pihito?
an4.103:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.103:2.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. ayaṃ dukkha samudayoti …pe… ayaṃ dukkha nirodhoti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.103:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo tuccho hoti pihito.
an4.103:2.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave kumbho tuccho pihito,
an4.103:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo pūro hoti vivaṭo?
an4.103:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.103:3.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.103:3.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo pūro hoti vivaṭo.
an4.103:3.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave kumbho pūro vivaṭo,
an4.103:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo tuccho hoti vivaṭo?
an4.103:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.103:4.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.103:4.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo tuccho hoti vivaṭo.
an4.103:4.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave kumbho tuccho vivaṭo,
an4.103:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave puggalo pūro hoti pihito?
an4.103:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ.
an4.103:5.3: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.103:5.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo pūro hoti pihito.
an4.103:5.5: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave kumbho pūro pihito,
an4.103:5.7: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro kumbhūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
